items.title: Producer group signals it may raise output next quarter
items.summary: Delegates of a producer group said members are discussing a gradual increase in supply, which could ease tightness in the crude market.

items.title: Tanker delays reported at a major shipping strait
items.summary: Shipping trackers reported delays for tankers passing a strait, raising short-term concerns about seaborne crude deliveries.

items.title: Refinery maintenance season begins across several regions
items.summary: Several refineries started scheduled maintenance, which may temporarily reduce crude purchases.
